nodes.title: Per-field semantics guidance beside the capability form's output_schema editor
nodes.summary: A short guidance paragraph, rendered beside the shared JsonTextareaField in the one CapabilityFormFields component both the dialog and the routed detail screen compose, states what the platform reads from output_schema and what a description may say — a hint, never enforced.

nodes.title: Glossary browser reads and shows a concept's description, marking legacy concepts awaiting one
nodes.summary: use-glossary-concepts.ts now narrows description off the concepts listing, the Concepts tab renders it per concept with a status-dot marker for an empty (legacy) description, and use-concept-options.ts's deliberate omission of description is disclosed as a departure from its sibling's shape.

nodes.title: Named UiErrorState kind for ConceptDescriptionRequiredError
nodes.summary: The central error-ui-state table gains a distinct concept-description-required kind for the backend's ConceptDescriptionRequiredError, carrying no wording, with every existing mapping left untouched.

nodes.title: Concept form authors and validates the description, and its refusal reaches the operator by name
nodes.summary: The existing concept create/edit form gains a required description field through create and edit, submits it in the registration body, and its failure path renders the concept-description-required UiErrorState with its own wording while every other failure still falls through to the generic toast.

nodes.title: Snapshot fields on the simulate wire types and adapter
nodes.summary: Both simulate hooks' wire evidence types gain optional fields and concept_description, and toDetailEvidence carries both onto the Detail region's own render type, which declares the identical honest-empty reading for a record collected before the snapshot existed.

nodes.title: Evidence tab renders the snapshotted concept_description and field semantics
nodes.summary: Two new render helpers show each evidence item's snapshotted concept_description and per-field semantics, distinguishing a pre-snapshot record (renders nothing new) from an honestly empty one (renders a stated absence), reading only from the simulation response already in hand.

nodes.title: Output_schema field-semantics guidance — proof
nodes.summary: Three new tests prove the guidance renders in both compositions of CapabilityFormFields and states meaning-versus-decision; criteria 5 and 6 are not independently tested, with why recorded.

nodes.title: Glossary browser description column and legacy marker — proof
nodes.summary: Six new tests across three spec files establish that the concept shape carries description, the Concepts tab renders it, an empty description gets a visible non-invented marker, its column placement, and use-concept-options' continued omission of description.

nodes.title: Proof for the concept-description-required UiErrorState kind
nodes.summary: Two new tests in the existing error-ui-state.spec.ts, in the same per-entry style already used for every prior single-entry addition, prove the new table entry resolves to its own distinct kind and carries no wording; the third criterion is already proven by the untouched pre-existing suite.

nodes.title: Concept form description field — proof
nodes.summary: New tests prove the description field populates on edit, is required, and its own missing-description refusal reaches the operator by name; three sibling spec files from a closed initiative's own delivery are corrected (with the human's explicit authorization) since this task's own required description field legitimately widens the PUT body and the validation surface they exercise.

nodes.title: Snapshot wire types and adapter — proof
nodes.summary: New tests prove both wire types accept the optional snapshot fields and toDetailEvidence carries them through unchanged in all three states (present-and-populated, present-but-empty, absent).

nodes.title: Evidence tab snapshot rendering — proof
nodes.summary: Seven new tests prove concept_description and per-field semantics render when present, degrade to a stated absence when empty, and render nothing new for a legacy record carrying neither.

nodes.title: evidence-semantics-frontend, full review
nodes.summary: What the coverage, specification-conformance and standard-conformance passes found over all six delivered tasks of the evidence-semantics-frontend initiative; the failures pass did not run because the captured whole-change run passed clean.
unproven: JsonTextareaField's props and rendering are unchanged for its other consumers.
The render type declares the snapshot optional, with the absent reading for records collected before the snapshot existed stated at the read site.
The semantics rendered are read only from the simulation response, with no glossary or capability-registry request issued to enrich them.
The sibling narrowing in use-concept-options continues to omit description, with the omission disclosed in its header comment as a deliberate departure from the sibling shape.
conceptFormSchema requires a non-empty description, with the mirroring of the backend DTO disclosed in the module's header comment.
